newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot resids mostly hold despite crude selloff.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot resids mostly hold despite crude selloff.

text.p: U.S. spot residual fuel prices mostly held steady Thursday in sluggish trade, helped by a buoyant high sulphur market despite another selloff in crude and still-stagnant utility demand, market sources said.

"The market is not really reacting to the weakness in crude. High sulphur still has some pretty good support from the Caribbean and Central America," said one cash trader, referring to ongoing interest from Mexico for HS barrels.
In New York Harbor, physical one percent was steady to down slightly at $16.00-25 a barrel, with July paper talked 15-25 cents lower at $16.00-35 with softer crude, traders said.
